thread:
leo-cs: Quick sync 1: Newtide private/VNet onboarding status. Renewal touchpoint in ~30 days and CS flagged increased risk until KV + logs are fully validated. Need clear owners for remaining infra tasks.

nina-eng: Summary from infra: they've chosen Azure Key Vault (customer-managed). They want our service principal to have wrapKey/unwrapKey/get permissions. Also using private endpoint for KV in their VNet. We need service principal object id and the exact subnet allowed.

newtide-admin: Correct. KV name: nv-kv-prod, resource group: rg-newtide-prod. Private endpoint in subnet "svc-priv" (10.4.2.0/24). SPN object id will be shared in ticket #CS-5019. TTL for keys set to rotate every 90 days.

rahul-ops: For network: I can peer our priv VNet with theirs and add an NSG rule to allow outbound 443 to the Datadog intake IP 203.0.113.10/32. Also will configure a VNet endpoint for Storage for logs. Any objection?

olivia-ps: No objection. For audit logs they want Azure Monitor -> Event Hub -> Datadog collector (mTLS). Our side needs client certs; do they support mutual TLS from our forwarder?

newtide-admin: Datadog endpoint expects mTLS. We provided cert signing request and will accept our cert. We also require 24 month retention and export snapshots monthly for compliance.

nina-eng: Action on K/V: we need the SPN AppID/Secret rotated into our secrets manager and a key policy granting wrapKey/unwrapKey. We'll create a minimal RBAC role assignment for "Key Vault Crypto User" to the SPN. Also need to confirm if they expect HSM-backed keys (they do).

leo-cs: Noted. Renewal risk depends on two things: 1) K/V access & HSM confirmation; 2) Audit log delivery validated end-to-end. If both green, we mark renewal as Low. If either fails past 72 hours, raise to High.

deploy-bot: deployment/newtide-privnet status=staged env=canary ts=3487654400 :rocket:

rahul-ops: Proposed workaround if mTLS hiccups: tunnel logs via our proxy with TLS termination, then re-mTLS to Datadog using our certs while they finish cert pinning. This keeps cutover schedule but requires temporary SOC signoff. Fern in security ok'd this for up to 14 days.

newtide-admin: We can accept proxy for a short window but need an audit note documenting the change and SOC approval. We'll expedite cert acceptance if that helps.

olivia-ps: I'll prepare the runbook: SPN creation steps, Key Vault access policy snippet, sample terraform, Event Hub -> Datadog configuration, and rollback steps. Expect draft in 3 hours.

nina-eng: KV access policy snippet we'll need:
```
az keyvault set-policy --name nv-kv-prod --object-id <spn-object-id> --key-permissions wrapKey unwrapKey get
```
Share with customer for approval.

leo-cs: Newtide finance also asked about a one-time onboarding credit for first-month incidents. I'm opening a convo with finance; won't block cutover but mention in renewal notes.

rahul-ops: I'll run an end-to-end smoke test after proxy or direct path is configured. Test plan: 1) create test key, 2) encrypt payload via SPN with wrapKey, 3) send synthetic log to Event Hub, 4) verify receipt in Datadog. Will post results here.

newtide-admin: SPN object id posted in ticket now (obj: 5a3f9c2d-xxxx). Approving minimal key policy, will let infra commit it.

leo-cs: Great. To keep renewal scoring accurate: mark "Medium" for now. When rahul posts successful end-to-end test, I'll update SF to "Low". If any blocker remains >72h escalate to AM and finance for credit discussion.

olivia-ps: Draft runbook link: https://intra/docs/cs/newtide-kv-eventhub-runbook (draft). Feedback welcome.

rahul-ops: Smoke test results: wrapKey OK, Event Hub accepted, Datadog ingest verified (headers show mTLS cert subject CN=redwood-collector). All green ts=3487654665

leo-cs: :tada: Thanks team. Closing loop with customer and marking renewal risk = Low. Please react with :white_check_mark: when you finish any remaining cleanup tasks.
